briefing: This trail is a significant climb with a total of 620 meters of climbing over 4.5 kilometers one way. The route features several steady ascents, including a steep section of 540 meters gaining 140 meters. Highlights include viewpoints like Sierra Point and the final destination, Nevada Fall. Be prepared for a long walk with varied terrain.

cues.title: Start
cues.text: You are at the start of the Mist Trail to Nevada Fall. There are toilets and an information board here.

cues.title: Turn left
cues.text: Turn left on John Muir Trail. The path straight ahead is not your route.

cues.title: Spring
cues.text: You will find a spring on your right.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 670 m long and gains 90 m.

cues.title: Sierra Point
cues.text: Sierra Point is a viewpoint on your left. It is about 100 m off the path.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 450 m long and gains 60 m.

cues.title: Drinking water tap
cues.text: A drinking water tap is beside the path. Toilets are beside the path.

cues.title: Straight on
cues.text: Continue straight onto Mist Trail. John Muir Trail on the right is not your route.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 540 m long and gains 140 m.

cues.title: Steps
cues.text: A flight of steps starts here. It is about 410 m long and climbs 124 m.

cues.title: Emerald Pool
cues.text: Emerald Pool comes into view on your right. There is a bench beside the path.

cues.title: Vernal Fall
cues.text: Vernal Fall is a waterfall on your left. It is about 50 m off the path.

cues.title: Silver Apron
cues.text: Silver Apron is a waterfall on your left. It is about 60 m off the path.

cues.title: Merced River
cues.text: The path crosses Merced River. There is a bridge, Mist Trail.

cues.title: Climb starts
cues.text: A steady climb starts here. It is 1.0 km long and gains 210 m.

cues.title: Turn right
cues.text: Turn right onto John Muir Trail. Toilets are beside the path.

cues.title: High point
cues.text: This is the highest point of the walk at about 1822 m.

cues.title: Finish
cues.text: This is the end of the route. Nevada Fall is a waterfall on your left.
